attBesluta.text: Practic, comod, ușor de montat, demontat. Suportul pentru picioare poate fi folosit sau nu în funcție de dorința. Preț corect
Parfait pour se mettre au bord de l'eau et regarder les bateaux. Vive le camping avec cette chaise pliable
Nice drawers. Easy to assemble. Depth is deceptive, my fault not looking at measurements.

I’m not able to finish putting it together because the holes in one of the drawer fronts are in the wrong place. Otherwise it’s decent and worth the price. It’s definitely a lot of work to assemble and the drawers could be much bigger judging by the size of the drawer fronts. There’s a lot of wasted space. I may return it but hopefully don’t have too if I can get a replacement for the drawer front with the wrong holes.

Kist gekocht voor opslag gereedschap; zelf binnenwerk gemaakt hiervoor. Op tijd geleverd, volgens afspraak, was netjes verpakt. Mooie kist, goede poedercoating, twee sleutels voor slot, helemaal prima.
Nice aluminum truck tool box. It is not heavy duty. Wish the aluminum was thicker.
I used it to edge a new pathway, very clean result, easy to work with, I would buy it again for my next edging job, very satisfied.

Todo corresponde con la compra, cumple con las necesidades de la foto y merece la pena, muy recomendable si buscas salir de un apuro, Estética muy conseguida y resultado de montaje sencillo. Eso si transporte mucho cuidado, algunas piezas son de latón fácil de doblar y tener problemas a largo plazo, pero para una instalación fija bien.
Not bad quality is good and the chrome looks nice. A couple of the posts came bent but other than that theyre nice
